citations.quote:
Attaching SOW-2 for the retail media project. As discussed, we'll be starting on 12 October. For your records, we're adding two sub-processors under the DPA:

1. Kriti Data Labs Pvt Ltd (Bengaluru) — model development

findings.standard: DPA (EU) or BAA (US health) signed before any personal/regulated data moves, with a sub-DPA / sub-BAA for every party that touches the data (incl. AtliQ's own Pune entity); engagement-specific scope; offshore access only as the agreement allows.
findings.counterPosition: Issue the formal sub-processor notice at least 30 days prior to the date any personal data is shared with or processed by Kriti Data Labs or SyncRiver.

hits.heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
hits.label: untagged
hits.text:
5.1 The total Fees under SOW-1 are **USD 33,000** (United States Dollars Thirty-Three Thousand only), comprising build fees payable on Milestones and a Monthly Support Fee for the support period, as detailed in SOW-1.

5.2 AtliQ shall invoice build fees upon completion of each Milestone and the Monthly Support Fee monthly in arrears. Sunrise shall pay each undisputed invoice within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.

5.3 All amounts are exclusive of GST, which shall be charged additionally at the applicable rate. Sunrise may deduct TDS as required by law.

5.4 Delayed payments shall attract interest at twelve percent (12%) per annum.
hits.differs: Better for AtliQ than Sunrise Foods: billed monthly on time-and-materials hourly rates rather than fixed fees tied to milestone delivery.

hits.heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
hits.label: standard
hits.text:
4.1 The total fees for the Services are **USD 48,000** (United States Dollars Forty-Eight Thousand only), payable on completion of Milestones as set out in Annexure A.

4.2 The Service Provider shall raise an invoice upon completion of each Milestone. The Company shall pay each undisputed invoice within forty-five (45) days of receipt of the invoice.

4.3 All fees are exclusive of GST. The Company shall be entitled to deduct TDS as applicable.

4.4 Any disputed amount shall be notified within ten (10) days of receipt of invoice, and the Parties shall resolve such dispute in good faith within thirty (30) days.
hits.differs: Better for AtliQ than Trustline NBFC: payment is due within 30 days instead of 45 days, and billed monthly on time-and-materials.

hits.heading: FEES AND PAYMENT
hits.label: untagged
hits.text:
5.1 The total Fees for SOW-1 are **USD 185,000** (one hundred and eighty-five thousand United States Dollars), payable against Milestones as set out in Schedule 1.

5.2 The Supplier shall invoice upon achievement of each Milestone. Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt.

5.3 All Fees are exclusive of VAT and any other applicable taxes. Where the Client is required by law to withhold tax, it shall provide the Supplier with the relevant withholding certificate.

5.4 Late payments shall bear interest at one percent (1%) per month from the due date until the date of payment.

5.5 The Client may dispute any invoice in good faith by written notice within ten (10) Business Days of receipt, and shall pay the undisputed portion by the due date.
hits.differs: Worse for AtliQ than Al Noor Hospitality Group: lacks late payment interest of 1% per month on overdue invoices.
